ideas.pitch: An AI-driven platform that analyses GitHub profiles, resumes, and coding activity to automatically assess current skill levels and map them directly to targeted job descriptions.
ideas.problem_statement: Where do I currently stand in terms of my skills and what skills do I need to develop for my desired career?
ideas.title: SkillGapAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly answers the core challenge questions set by UnsaidTalks Education by focusing heavily on automated skill discovery and actionable gap analysis using structured LLM extraction.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic milestone generator that takes a student's career goal and builds a hyper-personalized project-based learning roadmap with embedded auto-graded quizzes.
ideas.problem_statement: What should I do next to achieve my career goals and build a portfolio?
ideas.title: RoadmapGen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines personalized learning paths with dynamic assessment generation, mimicking proven winning formats from educational-tech hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A resume-driven mock interview simulator that generates role-specific technical and behavioral questions, giving real-time structured feedback to boost career readiness.
ideas.problem_statement: Career Discovery and Role Recommendations and Progress Tracking
ideas.title: HirePrep Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven patterns from mock interview and coaching applications that successfully won national AI hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support platform utilizing LangGraph to guide users through career exploration, resume auditing, and micro-learning modules.
ideas.problem_statement: Core Focus Areas: Artificial Intelligence and Personalisation and Career Discovery
ideas.title: AgenticCareerPath
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes multi-agent orchestration architectures that heavily appeal to technical judges looking for complex agentic workflows.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent portfolio builder that parses static student project repositories and transforms them into interactive, recruiters-ready case studies with automated skill tagging.
ideas.title: PortfolioForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the documentation and presentation bottleneck for student job seekers, directly aligning with the hackathon's portfolio development focus.
